description:
Check whether company-level email sending is active, paused, or suspended, and what it takes to restore it. Relevant whenever a send, test send, or sequence step fails for a reason that is not a validation error, and whenever the account reports a bounce or complaint rate problem.

Returns the pause reason and reason kind, when it was paused, the automated sender-health review state, whether the one-click resume is currently available (and if not, which gate is blocking it), the enforcement counts and thresholds for permanent bounces, temporary bounces, and complaints, and ordered remediation steps.

There is no rolling window and no expiry. Enforcement uses all-time totals counted from a reset watermark, so a paused rate does NOT decay over time. Waiting does not restore sending. The rate only changes as real (non-test) sends accumulate or when a resume moves the watermark. `metricsWindow` contains the exact watermark timestamps.

Requires the account:read scope, so a read-only key can diagnose a blocked account. resume_sending restores sending once the underlying problem is fixed.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sending_status

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sending_status` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

metricsWindow.description: Proof that enforcement is not time-windowed: kind is always all_time_since_reset and expiresAt is always null. bounceResetAt and complaintResetAt are the watermarks the totals are counted from. Do not tell the user to wait for a window to expire - there is none.

pauseReason.description: Exact enforcement message, including the measured rate, the threshold it crossed, and the send volume it was measured over. Null when sending is active.

pauseReasonKind.description: Machine-readable pause cause: high_hard_bounce_rate, high_soft_bounce_rate, high_block_rate, high_complaint_rate, phishing_guard, over_email_limit, manual, or other. Only high_hard_bounce_rate can be cleared with resume_sending; over_email_limit lifts automatically once the account has email allowance again.

pausedAt.description: ISO timestamp when sending was paused. Null when sending is active.

remediation.description: Ordered steps for the current state, plus supportEmail, docsUrl, and the dashboard URL. Relay these verbatim instead of improvising recovery advice.

selfResume.description: Whether the account can clear this pause itself: canSelfResume, supported, allowedByAdmin, ownerIsTrusted, the automated aiReviewStatus (not_required, pending, approved, flagged, failed) with its reason and timestamps, and unavailableReason naming the blocking gate (unsupported_reason, waiting_for_review, blocked_by_ai, review_failed, blocked_by_admin).

senderHealth.description: Enforcement counts and the thresholds that apply at this volume for hard bounces, soft bounces, blocks (block: receivers refusing the sender for spam or content, its domain, policy, or failed SPF, DKIM or DMARC), and complaints. bounceScopedSent is the denominator for bounce rates, blockScopedSent (test sends included) is the denominator for the block rate, complaintScopedSent is the denominator for complaint rates, and scopedSent remains as a backward-compatible alias for bounceScopedSent. Also includes enforcementMode. Null when the account has no metrics record yet or sender-health analytics are temporarily unavailable; pause state and remediation remain authoritative.

status.description: Company-level sending state: active, paused, or suspended. Anything other than active blocks every send, including test sends.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
